parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Breakpoint.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` and `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` — carry `is_test: true` and reside in the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package. These are stub factory methods for distinct domain types (`Breakpoint` and `Playcut`), and their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) is expected for test-fixture builders that follow a common `.stub()` naming convention. Generalising them into a single generic function would couple unrelated test-data shapes and reduce readability in test code without meaningful production benefit.
